question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

An order of law requiring people to remain indoors
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"An order of law requiring people to remain indoors"** refers to a legal restriction that mandates individuals to stay inside their homes during specified hours. (कानून का आदेश जो लोगों को घर के अंदर रहने की आवश्यकता होती है)

 
 
• **Example:** During the riots, the government imposed **a curfew **to maintain order.
 
 
 
• **"Curfew"** is a regulation requiring people to remain indoors between specified hours, typically at night. (कर्फ्यू)
 
 
• **Example:** The city declared** a curfew** starting at 9 PM to prevent any further disturbances.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct word for **"An order of law requiring people to remain indoors"** is **"Curfew"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Curfew**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Restriction** (प्रतिबंध): A limiting condition or measure, especially a legal one.

 
 
• **Example:** The government has placed restrictions on large gatherings to prevent the spread of the virus.
 
 
 
• **Limit** (सीमा): A point or level beyond which something does not or may not extend or pass.
 
 
• **Example:** There is a limit to how much weight this bridge can hold.
 
 
 
• **Check in** (चेक इन): The act of reporting one's presence, typically at a hotel or airport.
 
 
• **Example:** We need to check in at the hotel by 3 PM.
